title: Framework 13 AMD 7040 Series Suspend Problems
body: NOTE: as I went to post this, I found that KDE's baloo_file indexing service was blocking suspend. Killing it allows suspend to function. However, that only lasted for 4 suspend cycles, before sleep started failing again. I continue to diagnose. Folks, I have a Framework 13 AMD Ryzen 7 7840U with 64gb of RAM, a 1 TB NVME SSD, the 2.8k screen and Intel AX210 WiFi. The machine generally works very well, but suspend and resume has been quite a problem, as others have experienced. When running BIOS 3.05, the machine would usually suspend and resume fine, when on battery power, but not when plugged in. Once I upgraded to BIOS 3.07, it no longer suspends at all. I have used several different good quality USB-C PSUs, in case that is the problem, but that doesn't seem to make a difference. I am currently running kernel 6.13.6-arch1-1, and using KDE Plasma 6. My installation is pretty generic, as I reinstalled the machine when I upgraded the mainboard from the older Framework i7 1135G7 board.
